$comment: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata (RFC 8414) for the Razorpay MCP server. These endpoints are MCP protocol endpoints — they are not browser-navigable. For setup instructions see service_documentation. The Razorpay REST API (api.razorpay.com) uses HTTP Basic Auth with API keys, not OAuth.

agent_auth.notes: Live API keys require human 2FA on the Dashboard. Agents cannot self-provision live credentials.

x-api-key-auth.description: Primary authentication for the Razorpay REST API: HTTP Basic Auth using key_id as username and key_secret as password. API keys are generated from the Razorpay Dashboard.
